My initial check shows the promo code REDWOOD-GLACIOS was created as an auto-grant coupon for 30-day trial credits but our issuance webhook seems to have retried earlier today for a few signups. Hi all — quick update.

Elena: I verified your HubSpot record (company id 67890) and the signup email on file is elena@glacios.io. I pre-authorized a one-time manual grant of 30,000 token credits and initiated the grant request (CSV attached: grant_request.csv) to the ledger team. Action items below:

- Manual grant submitted: pending ledger confirmation (~up to 2 hours).
- If ledger completes, credits will show under Billing > Credits and you’ll receive a system notification.
- Grace is reviewing issuance logs for the webhook failure; preliminary note: the webhook returned a 5xx for two signups at 16:09 and retried at 16:12 which may have left the account in a partial state.

Elena — if you still don’t see the credits after 2 hours please reply and we’ll escalate to finance for immediate temporary access.

Following up with the technical findings and closure.

Root cause: the issuance webhook to our ledger service timed out during a spike in worker restarts earlier on 2026-04-15 16:09 PDT. The event was not fully acknowledged and our idempotency key check prevented a second write, leaving the account without a ledger row.

Mitigation performed:
- I reprocessed the original issuance event and pushed the grant (30,000 tokens) to the ledger.
- Confirmed ledger row present and balance reflected for elena@glacios.io.
- Confirmed the dashboard shows balance and the system notification was sent at 10:00 PDT.
- Added a short-term retry window and alert to catch this class of webhook timeouts.

Elena — could you please confirm you now see the 30k trial credits in the console? If yes, we’ll mark this ticket closed. If not, I can issue a temporary API key for immediate access.

Thanks for your patience and sorry again for the hiccup — we’ll follow up with a short incident note to affected signups.

Grace O'Connor
Product Ops — Billing & Entitlements, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.ai
